description: accepted=true closes the task and, for a card hold, captures it. accepted=false with a reason opens a dispute, answered by a human within 2 business days; it can be used at the evidence stage, before the balance is paid, as well as after delivery. Without either, the task counts as accepted 7 days after delivery.

reason.description: Required when accepted is false: what differs from the quote.

name: confirm_delivery
